tools.name: ceipal_list_job_postings
tools.description: List job postings, one page at a time. Read only. GET /v2/getJobPostingsList/. Reads are limited to 60 a minute per account token.

tools.name: ceipal_list_job_requisitions
tools.description: List job requisitions, one page at a time. Read only. GET /v2/getRequisitionsList/. Reads are limited to 60 a minute per account token.

tools.name: ceipal_list_applicants

tools.name: ceipal_get_job_posting
tools.description: Get one job posting by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_job_postings. Read only. GET /v2/getJobPostingDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_job_requisition
tools.description: Get one job requisition by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_job_requisitions. Read only. GET /v2/getRequistionsDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_applicant
tools.description: Get one applicant with documents and custom fields by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_applicants. Read only. GET /v2/getApplicantDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_submission
tools.description: Get one submission by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_submissions. Read only. GET /v2/getSubmissionDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_bench_consultant
tools.description: Get one bench consultant by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_talent_bench. Read only. GET /v2/getBenchDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_client
tools.description: Get one client with contacts and accounts by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_clients. Read only. GET /v2/getClientDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_lead

tools.name: ceipal_get_vendor

tools.name: ceipal_get_interview
tools.description: Get one interview by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_interviews. Read only. GET /v2/getInterviewDetails/{id}/.

tools.name: ceipal_get_placement
tools.description: Get one placement with pay details by its encrypted id from ceipal_list_placements. Read only. GET /v2/getPlacementDetails/{id}/.
